info.title: Terminal REST API
info.description: Read-only market analytics. All market responses use the common envelope (schemaVersion, requestId, symbol, asOf, fetchedAt, source, provenanceByField, unitsByField, freshness, coverage, assumptions, warnings, data). Provider keys never leave the server.
